implementation: RNG Implementation for the Armor Cryptographic Processor ASIC
description: The Armor cryptographic processor is used in security modules embedded in Motorola's Astro family of radio system products. It provides secure voice and data capabilities as well as APCO Over-The-Air-Rekeying and advanced key management.
